answer_1.quote: We aim to understand how different LLMs respond when prompted with hate speech... We analyse the reactions of seven state-of-the-art LLMs to more than 26 000 English hate speech sentences, simulating potential user interactions when not required to perform any specific task; they simply generate content in a vanilla mode.
